commands.command: . ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null && echo '=== FIND EMULATOR ELF ===' && find tests/zigbee_device_emulator -maxdepth 3 -type f -name 'zigbee_device_emulator.elf' -print -exec ls -lh {} \; && ELF=$(find tests/zigbee_device_emulator -maxdepth 3 -type f -name 'zigbee_device_emulator.elf' | head -1) && test -n "$ELF" && echo ELF=$ELF && echo '=== CONFIG ===' && grep -E 'CONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_(IAS_CONTACT|MIXED)=|CONFIG_ESP_CONSOLE_USB_SERIAL_JTAG=' tests/zigbee_device_emulator/sdkconfig || true && echo '=== CORRECT C6 ADDR2LINE ===' && riscv32-esp-elf-addr2line -pfiaC -e "$ELF" 0x42030dd5 0x42030dd8 0x408075e0 0x4080759e 0x4206357c 0x42039a74 0x4200a9d4 0x4200a8fa 0x4200a4b4 0x42006fd0 && echo '=== NEAREST SYMBOLS AROUND 0x42030dd5 ===' && riscv32-esp-elf-nm -n -C "$ELF" | awk '$1 >= "42030c00" && $1 <= "42030f50" {print}' | head -120 && echo '=== MAP HITS ===' && MAP=${ELF%.elf}.map && if [ -f "$MAP" ]; then grep -n -B4 -A8 -E '42030dd[0-9a-f]|42030d[0-9a-f]{2}' "$MAP" | head -160 || true; fi
